name: sumTo_eq
prelude:
def sumTo : Nat → Nat
  | 0 => 0
  | n + 1 => sumTo n + (n + 1)
statement: theorem sumTo_eq (n : Nat) : 2 * sumTo n = n * (n + 1)
proofs:
induction n with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ n ih =>
    rw [sumTo, Nat.mul_add, ih, ← Nat.add_mul, Nat.mul_comm]
  induction n with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ n ih =>
    simp only [sumTo, Nat.mul_add, Nat.add_mul, Nat.mul_one, Nat.one_mul, ih]
    omega
